user.title: Connect forecasting service
user.description: Use the service's reachable LAN URL and a scoped integration token. Complete site configuration in the service GUI.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check URL, site ID, network and service availability.

init.title: Select input sources and history
init.description: Select sensors and composition in the Energy Forecast service setup. This screen controls history backfill and can discover an additional source. Guide: {guide}

discover.title: Select a measured source
discover.description: Recorder statistics include inactive historical IDs. Check units and AC/DC boundaries before selecting. Forecast output entities are excluded.

error.invalid_inputs: Invalid source, history date or forecast output selected as input.
